program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
    (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
      (let ((cols (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) color)) (range 0 (cols g)))))
        (if (and (= (length cols) 2)
                 (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 0)) (range (+ (first cols) 1) (second cols))))
            (for/fold ([row-out acc])
                      ([c (in-range (+ (first cols) 1) (second cols))]
                       [k (in-naturals 1)])
              (if (= (modulo k 2) 1) (set-cell row-out r c color) row-out))
            acc)))))
